players.bio: Adrien Thibaut is a 20-year-old Football player. Born on 2004-07-11, he plays as Forward for Crewe Alexandra, in England.
Calum Agius (born 5 September 2005) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Crewe Alexandra.
Charlie Martin McNeill is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Crewe Alexandra on loan from EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday.

Conor Thomas (born 29 October 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Crewe Alexandra. He has previously played for Coventry City, Swindon Town, former Indian Super League club ATK and Cheltenham Town.
Ian John Lawlor (born 27 October 1994) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Crewe Alexandra.

Jack Richard Lankester (born 19 January 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League Two club Crewe Alexandra, having previously played for Ipswich Town and Cambridge United.
Joe Peter White (born 1 October 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for EFL League Two club Crewe Alexandra.
Joel William Tabiner (born 30 November 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Crewe Alexandra.
Jordan Lewis Gibson (born 28 February 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League Two side Crewe Alexandra.
Joshua Thomas March (born 18 March 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League Two club Crewe Alexandra.
Kyle Ure is a 20-year-old Scottish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for English League Two club Crewe Alexandra, on loan from Scottish Premiership champions Celtic.
Lee Bell (born 26 January 1983) is an English former professional footballer who played as a midfielder. He is currently manager of Crewe Alexandra.

Lewis Carl Billington (born 17 February 2004) is an English professional footballer plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Crewe Alexandra. Billington signed a scholarship deal with Crewe Alexandra's Academy in 2020.
Luke William Offord (born 19 November 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender or midfielder for Crewe Alexandra .
Matúš Holíček (born 25 January 2005) is a Slovakian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Crewe Alexandra.

Michael David Demetriou (born 12 March 1990) is an English footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Crewe Alexandra. He has played internationally for England C, making his debut against Bermuda on 4 June 2013.
Owen Alan Lunt (born 2 September 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Crewe Alexandra.

Owen Taylor is a 19-year-old professional footballer from England who plays as a central midfielder for Crewe Alexandra F.C.. Born on 26 August 2007 in Nantwich, he is a product of the Crewe Alexandra academy system.

Reece Christopher Hutchinson (born 14 April 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Crewe Alexandra. Hutchinson, who can play anywhere down the left or as an attacking midfielder, spent time out on loan at Romulus in the 2017/18 season. The youngster signed a one-year deal.

Stan Dancey is a 19-year-old professional footballer who plays as a defender for Crewe Alexandra F.C.. Dancey joined the Crewe Alexandra Academy at the Under-12 level. He signed his first professional contract with the club in June 2025 and recently signed a fresh contract extension in August 2026, keeping him at the club until June 2027 with a further one-year option.
Thomas Luke Booth (born 2 August 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Crewe Alexandra.
